units: Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ שער הי׳, v. יָסַד.—Esp. (sub. המזבח) the base of the altar, y’sod.
Zeb. V, 1, a. fr. י׳ מערבי the western side of the y’sod.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Ib. 3</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 53a:14">53ᵃ</cite>) <he>י׳ דרומית</he> (read <cite ref="D01060"><he>דרומי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) the southern side &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְסוֹדוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:6">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>אביו בנה את הי׳</he> Solomon’s father laid the foundations of the Temple; a. e.
